purpose: Isolated nutrient sensitivity and selected journey integration; not historical measurements or a matched survival comparison.

sensitivity.preview_note: The full dictionary differs when committed whole hay units are charged; preview reserves physical amounts without consuming them.

limits: Body sizes, nutrient coefficients and travel increments are explicit proxy assumptions.
Habitat/month caps still approximate quantity; natural nutrient quality remains species-specific and constant.
Protein/minerals, temporary body-reserve milk and local herd competition are not simulated.
Raw experiments stay in local ignored .tools; reproduction requires frozen runtime and scripts.
